layman_headline: Market fear is keeping us on the sidelines — no strong enough setup to risk money right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood (27 out of 100 on the Fear & Greed scale), and it's been getting worse all week. Bitcoin is holding around $64,000, but altcoins are getting beaten up — especially DeFi tokens like Lido and Ether.fi which have dropped 12-22% this week. While some of these dips look tempting, the overall environment is hostile to altcoins because Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.6%, meaning money is flowing out of smaller coins and into Bitcoin. Without stronger confirmation signals, jumping in now would be catching a falling knife.
layman_action: Stay in cash and watch. If the Fear & Greed index drops to 20 or below, or if LDO finds clear support near $0.27 with a volume spike, that could be a better entry. Don't chase dips in this environment.
expert_reasoning: The market is in a Fear regime (27, trending worse from 25 yesterday, 26.7 weekly avg) which per my validated rules makes the short-term outlook genuinely ambiguous — HOLD is the safest call. BTC dominance at 56.6% is actively compressing altcoin valuations, creating a headwind for all swing candidates. LDO's -22.4% weekly drop with RSI at 42.7 (not yet oversold) and a neutral chart bias of -0.10 suggests the sell-off may not be complete. The 2.91x R/R is attractive but I have no MACD, funding rate, or volume data to confirm accumulation. Multiple data gaps across candidates (no RSI for AAVE/ETHFI, no chart analysis for most) reduce conviction below actionable thresholds. I'm flagging LDO as the top watchlist item for a potential entry if RSI dips below 35 or if support at $0.30 holds with volume confirmation.
